Plot the trend of an official DHS indicator

Source: R/plot.R
bdhs_plot_trend.Rd

Draws an official indicator from bdhs_indicators across survey rounds, nationally or by a background characteristic, with 95% confidence intervals where the DHS Program publishes them. Survey rounds are placed on a true time scale and labelled with their survey years.

Usage

bdhs_plot_trend(indicator, by = NULL, survey = NULL, ci = TRUE)

Arguments

indicator

One or more DHS indicator ids (see bdhs_search()). Several indicators are drawn in separate panels.

by

NULL (default) for the national value, or a characteristic category such as "Residence", "Wealth quintile", "Education", "Region" or "Division".

survey

Optional survey references to restrict the rounds shown.

ci

If TRUE (default), draw 95% confidence intervals when the DHS Program publishes them for the indicator.

Value

A ggplot object.

Details

Subnational trends come in two flavours. by = "Region" uses the five regions that are comparable across every round (Barishal, Chattogram/Sylhet, Dhaka before 2015 (incl. Mymensingh), Khulna, Rajshahi/Rangpur). by = "Division" uses the divisions as surveyed in each round (Sylhet from 1996-97, Rangpur from 2011, Mymensingh from 2017-18); with more than eight series these are drawn as small multiples.

See also

bdhs_official() for the numbers behind the plot.

Examples

bdhs_plot_trend("FE_FRTR_W_TFR")

bdhs_plot_trend("CN_NUTS_C_HA2", by = "Residence")

bdhs_plot_trend("CM_ECMR_C_U5M", by = "Region")
